text:
maria: noticing p99 tail spikes on pool-3 when jobs hit long contexts (>12k tokens). p99 jumps from ~120ms -> ~560ms. KV cache resident memory grows for a while then we see heavy paging/evict churn. anyone seen this before?

runtime-bot: perf-alert: pool-3 p99 spike detected (alert_id=perf-2119). linked incident: https://redwood/incidents/2119

alex: can you paste the KV stats snapshot and a minimal repro command? also which evict policy is active on that pool?

maria: quick kv snapshot from the host during a spike: 
```
total_entries: 2048000
active_entries: 1920000
free_pages: 64
fragmentation_pct: 28
evict_policy: lru
evict_batch_latency_ms: 320
reuse_check_ms: 110
kv_pager_evictions/sec: 450
long_context_rate: 0.14
```
Also attached a tiny flame excerpt (copied): `kv_pager::evict_loop` -> `kv_cache::reinsert` -> `kv_pager::write_page` showing a big tail on evict_loop.

sam: ran a quick canary: switched pool-3 canary to evict_policy=fifo for 6h. p99 dropped to ~220ms but p50 increased ~15ms. observed less mem regrowth but more steady throughput. not a full proof but interesting signal.

jordan: suspect reinsert ordering interacts badly with long-context reuse. vowel: if reuse triggers a reinsert that puts the entry at tail (or head depending on impl) we might be evicting entries that are actually hot for ongoing long-token sessions. possible race with batching threads where the reuse_check doesn't bump recency atomically.

alex: can you run with debug flags and a tight repro? try: `./bin/stress-run --model gptx --pool pool-3 --long-context 14000 --concurrency 8 --kv-pager-debug=1 --sample-rate 1` capture `kv_pager.debug` logs + pprof at the spike.

maria: will run the canary now with `--kv-pager-debug=1` and keep fifo/lru toggles. leaving it to someone to own the trace collection/analysis.

jordan: I'll own the repro and traces. planning to run a 3h continuous job with the stress-run above, capture perf traces every 10m, and collect kv bitmap dumps when fragmentation_pct > 20. ping me in thread if you want the raw traces.

sam: small profiling snippet from the fifo canary at 02:14: 
```
# top 3 samples
kv_pager::evict_batch 340ms (42%)
kv_cache::reuse_check 120ms (15%)
threadpool::work_loop 40ms (5%)
```
shows evict_batch is still the main tail cost even under fifo, but reuse_check dropped.

alex: good data. next actions: (1) jordan to repro + traces (2) maria to run lru vs fifo A/B for another 24h (3) eng-runtime to review reinsert atomicity in `kv_cache` (PR candidate: make reinsert a CAS that updates recency index).

maria: noted. I'll start the 24h A/B and share dashboards. owner for rollback if latency regresses? recommended: rollback to fifo canary config.

jordan: got it, starting run now. will post first trace in ~15m.

runtime-bot: perf-alert acknowledged by eng-runtime oncall.
